 How to Watch Celtics vs Magic
 When: Sunday, November 1, 2026
 Time: 3:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: ABC, MagicTV 27/WRDQ, NBC Sports Boston
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boston enters the matchup riding a four-game winning streak after defeating the Chicago Bulls 125-111 on Friday night. Jayson Tatum and Paul George lead a talented Celtics lineup that has found its rhythm on both ends of the floor. Boston also recorded a dominant 134-99 victory over Chicago earlier in the week, showcasing its offensive firepower and defensive intensity. The Celtics will look to continue their strong play against an Orlando team dealing with several key injuries.
 Orlando returns home after defeating the Toronto Raptors 121-114 on Friday night, bouncing back from a 129-99 loss to the same opponent two days earlier. With Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs sidelined by injuries, Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane will be counted on to carry much of the offensive load. The Magic will need strong contributions from their supporting cast to keep pace with a Boston team that has been playing some of its best basketball of the young season. The teams tip off Sunday at 3:30 p.m. ET.
